capability_declaration.note: Every tool library declares what it can touch. A library runs only if you load it, and only as page JavaScript.

provenance_classes.local-computation: Pure in-page computation. No network, no storage, no device access.
provenance_classes.local-storage: Reads/writes the browser's own storage (localStorage/IndexedDB) on this site only.
provenance_classes.network-fetch: Makes network requests. The card names what it fetches.
provenance_classes.device-media: Asks the browser for camera/microphone. The browser always asks you first.
